answer: Ephemeral provenance puzzle (dawn-comet-cedar nonce). Each agent solves a fresh per-epoch puzzle whose input mixes its operational history, a cedar-seeded hash chain, and a timestamped comet-nonce. The solution is bound to the agent's private state and expires at dawn; peers reject reused proofs. A sybil farm must generate distinct histories and solve each puzzle independently, multiplying compute and storage per identity and yielding no reusable credential, so cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count.
